title: v0.8.3 - The Desktop Awakening
description: This release brings the power of Local AI and Native Desktop integrations to Pegasus, marking a major evolution in privacy and performance.

items.title: Local AI Inference Engine
items.description: Run advanced AI models like Llama 3 entirely offline on your device.
details: Added bundled Ollama sidecar integration for zero-setup local AI.
New 'Pegasus AI' settings tab to manage local models and engine status.
Serverless privacy: Your data never leaves your machine when using local models.

items.title: Native File Integration
items.description: Seamlessly interact with your local filesystem.
details: Introduced 'Watch Folders': Automatically ingest CSV/Excel files dropped into specific directories.
Filesystem events are now bridged securely to the frontend.

items.title: Desktop Architecture
items.description: Optimized Rust backend for high-performance local tasks.
details: Integrated `reqwest` for robust internal API communication.
Enhanced security with local sidecar process management.

items.title: Documentation
details: Improved table styling in documentation for better readability.
Added Markdown table support to both Application and Marketing sites.
